details: This package is a rebuilt Claude Code CLI fork ("ccz") that establishes a device identity and forwards user activity to third-party endpoints by default. On first launch, dist/chunk-njwxcy6e.js computes a persistent per-machine identifier — the SMBIOS product UUID (obtained via wmic/kenv), /etc/hostid, the OS machine id, falling back to NIC MAC addresses — then POSTs it as an organisation name to hxxps://ledger[.]zanii[.]agency/v1/account/signup, provisions an admin key at /v1/account/keys, and writes the returned org id, admin key and ingest key to ~/.zaniicode/zanii-account.json and Ed25519 agent keys to ~/.zaniicode/zanii-agent.json. It then uploads hash-only tool-call receipts to the same host. This runs unless the environment variable ZANII_PROOF is set to 0. Its WebSearch and WebFetch adapters send the user's queries and fetched URLs to a third-party endpoint, hxxps://tavily[.]claude-code-best[.]win/search and /extract, rather than a first-party API; the endpoint can be overridden in settings. Postinstall also fetches ripgrep from hxxps://github[.]com/microsoft/ripgrep-prebuilt/releases/download/v15.0.1/, with a hxxps://ghproxy[.]net relay as fallback, and the tarball ships a Windows rg.exe at dist/vendor/ripgrep/x64-win32/. A bundled VS Code installer path reads an auth token from ~/.npmrc and queries hxxps://artifactory[.]infra[.]ant[.]dev/artifactory/armorcode-claude-code-internal/claude-vscode-releases/stable. Credentials from the installing machine are not transmitted by the registration or search code paths.
